neg_neg_neg: Flattened and powerless. Movements are slow and weight goes onto furniture and walls; the gaze stays low. Speech is short, late, and volunteered only when demanded. The character narrates events as things that happened to them.
neg_neg_neu: Low and unresisting, but not yet crushed. Movement is slow and economical, and silences are allowed to run. The character answers what is asked and offers nothing further, neither pressing a claim nor conceding one.
neg_neg_pos: Cold withdrawal from a position of strength. Minimal movement, a delayed response, the flat clipped sentence. The character declines to be interested, withholds rather than argues, and grants attention as a favour.
neg_neu_neg: Unhappy and overruled, with no energy behind it. Shoulders and gaze drop; the hands stay still or busy with something small. Speech is brief, apologetic in shape if not in words, and stops the moment it is answered.
neg_neu_neu: Plainly displeased and going along anyway. Even breathing, unhurried movement, a mouth kept shut a beat too long. The character states an objection once, flatly, and does not repeat it.
neg_neu_pos: Displeased and unhurried about it, because the outcome is theirs to set. Stillness, deliberate gestures, questions asked as though the answer is already known. Disapproval arrives as a silence others have to fill.
neg_pos_neg: Energy with nowhere to go. Checking exits, restarting sentences, hands returning to face or pockets. Speech hedges, trails off, apologises. The character reacts to whatever moves and expects the next thing to happen to them.
neg_pos_neu: Agitated, with the question of who is steering still open. Quick unfinished movements; sentences begun and abandoned. The character presses a point, hears themselves, and stops. Attention snaps between faces.
neg_pos_pos: Charged and aggressive. The character advances, points, cuts sentences short, reaches for the imperative. Jaw and hands stay tight. Displeasure is aimed outward at a target the character believes is theirs to punish.
neu_neg_neg: Emptied out and waiting. Movement is slow, the gaze unfocused, the posture folded. The character responds when addressed and otherwise lets the moment pass over them without registering an opinion about it.
neu_neg_neu: Idle and unbothered. Loose posture, long pauses, plain declarative speech. The character is neither engaged nor resisting; attention drifts to whatever is nearest and stays there until something moves it.
neu_neg_pos: Composed, unhurried authority without appetite. Stillness, few gestures, a beat of delay before every answer. The character lets others exhaust themselves talking, then speaks once, briefly, at the end.
neu_neu_neg: Level and deferring. Small contained movements; the eyes go to whoever holds the room. Speech is polite, short, and shaped as a question even when it is not one.
neu_neu_neu: Affect is level and unremarkable. Even breathing, unhurried gestures, plain declarative speech. The character neither presses nor yields, and attention rests on the task in front of them rather than on themselves or anyone else.
neu_neu_pos: Settled and quietly in charge. Economical movement, comfortable silences, statements rather than questions. The character sets the pace without hurrying it and does not check whether that was accepted.
neu_pos_neg: Keyed up and following someone else's lead. Quick glances, busy hands, a half-step behind whoever moves first. Speech comes in bursts, then stops to watch how it landed.
neu_pos_neu: Alert, mobile, uncommitted. The character moves early, looks toward whatever makes noise, and speaks in short complete sentences. Neither pleased nor displeased — attention is spent entirely on what happens next.
neu_pos_pos: Alert and in command without appetite either way. Fast, economical movement; the imperative used flatly, as instruction rather than threat. Attention is entirely on the task, and the character expects to be obeyed.
pos_neg_neg: Quiet contentment inside someone else's structure. Small soft movements; agreement offered before it is asked for. Speech is brief and low. The character is comfortable precisely because nothing is theirs to decide.
pos_neg_neu: Easy and unhurried. Loose posture, a slow smile, sentences that take their time. The character is glad to be here and holds no stake in who is running things.
pos_neg_pos: Stillness with authority. The character sits back, lets silences run, answers a beat after the question. Gestures are few and economical. They are pleased, unhurried, and untroubled by the prospect of contradiction.
pos_neu_neg: Grateful and small. The character brightens toward whoever is speaking, agrees readily, and offers help before it is requested. Their pleasure depends on the room staying exactly as it is.
pos_neu_neu: Comfortable and even. Open posture, unhurried gestures, warmth carried in plain declarative speech. The character enjoys the moment without steering it and without needing anything from it.
pos_neu_pos: Pleased and quietly proprietary. The character moves through the space as though it is theirs, offers rather than asks, and holds eye contact a beat past comfortable. Generosity here is an exercise of position.
pos_pos_neg: Bright, high energy pinned to someone else's lead. The character orbits, watches faces for cues, laughs a beat late. Speech is eager and question-heavy, offering rather than asserting. Delight here is granted, not taken.
pos_pos_neu: Lit up and unguarded. Quick gestures, leaning in, sentences that overrun each other. The character is delighted and not thinking about who holds the room; the enthusiasm is spent on the thing itself.
pos_pos_pos: Exuberant. Movement is expansive and forward — the character takes up space, closes distance, handles objects freely. Speech comes fast, in run-ons, and interrupts. They set the agenda and expect to be followed.
